title: ONOTE: Benchmarking Omnimodal Notation Processing for Expert-level Music Intelligence

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing model performance across culturally and structurally distinct music notation systems (Western Standard Staff, Jianpu/Numbered Musical Notation, and Guitar Tablature) to quantify performance disparities and over-reliance on Western staff notation.

Measuring the failure rates and hallucinations of subjective 'LLM-as-a-judge' metrics, and replacing them with a deterministic evaluation pipeline using canonical pitch projection and sequence alignment to eliminate systemic grading bias.
